blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateInventoryLocationsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step ensures that the inventory levels exist for each
specified pair of inventory item and location. If not,
the step will throw an error.

children.name: inventory_item_id
children.description: The ID of the associated inventory item.

children.name: location_id
children.description: The ID of the associated location.

children.name: stocked_quantity
children.description: The stocked quantity of the associated inventory item in the associated location.

children.name: incoming_quantity
children.description: The incoming quantity of the associated inventory item in the associated location.
